pack.title: Part3/4セット（会話10・トーク10）
pack.origin: エージェント直接執筆＋別モデル(Fable 5)AIクロスレビュー 2026-07

questions.script: A: Do you have a few minutes to talk about tomorrow's budget meeting? B: Actually, I just found out I have a client call at the same time. Could we reschedule it to Thursday afternoon? A: That should work — most of the team is free then. I'll send a new invite this afternoon. B: Great, thanks for being so flexible.

subQuestions.question: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

choices.text: Changing the time of a meeting

subQuestions.explanation: 会話全体はB氏が予定重複のため会議の時間変更を依頼する内容。契約解除・採用・予算内容の検討自体は話題になっていない。
subQuestions.translation: 話者たちは主に何について話していますか。

subQuestions.question: Why does B want to change the meeting time?

choices.text: B will be out of the office all week
B has not finished the budget report
B has a client call scheduled at the same time
B is waiting for a new team member

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"I just found out I have a client call at the same time"と述べている。他の理由はscript中に出てこない。
subQuestions.translation: Bはなぜ会議の時間を変更したいのですか。

subQuestions.question: What will A most likely do next?

choices.text: Ask B to lead the meeting

subQuestions.explanation: Aは"I'll send a new invite this afternoon"と明言している。
subQuestions.translation: Aは次に何をする可能性が高いですか。

questions.script: A: The shared server seems to be malfunctioning again — I can't access any of the project files. B: I noticed that too. I already called the technician, but he said he can't come until tomorrow morning. A: That's a problem. Do we have a backup we can use in the meantime? B: I'll check with IT and email you a temporary link within the hour.

subQuestions.question: What problem are the speakers discussing?

choices.text: A conference room is already booked
A shared server is not working properly
A printer has run out of ink

subQuestions.explanation: 冒頭でAが"the shared server seems to be malfunctioning"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 話者たちはどんな問題について話していますか。

subQuestions.question: When will the technician arrive?
subQuestions.explanation: Bが"he can't come until tomorrow morning"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 技術者はいつ到着しますか。

subQuestions.question: What does B imply will happen next?

choices.text: The server will be fixed immediately without help
A temporary way to access the files will be provided
A will be asked to work from home
The day's meetings will be canceled

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"I'll check with IT and email you a temporary link"と述べており、代替アクセス手段を提供する意図を示している。
subQuestions.translation: Bは次に何をするつもりだとほのめかしていますか。

questions.script: A: We're almost out of printer paper and toner in the supply closet. B: Really? I thought we just placed an order last month. A: We did, but the new interns have been printing a lot of training materials. B: Let's submit a request today so it arrives before the weekend.

subQuestions.question: What is the conversation mainly about?
subQuestions.explanation: 冒頭でAが用紙とトナーの残量が少ないことを伝えている。
subQuestions.translation: 会話は主に何についてですか。

subQuestions.question: According to A, why are supplies running low?

choices.text: New interns have been printing a lot of materials
The order from last month never arrived

subQuestions.explanation: Aが"the new interns have been printing a lot of training materials"と説明している。
subQuestions.translation: Aによると、なぜ備品が少なくなっているのですか。

subQuestions.question: What does B suggest doing?

choices.text: Asking the interns to stop printing

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"Let's submit a request today"と提案している。
subQuestions.translation: Bは何をすることを提案していますか。

questions.script: A: I just got off the phone with the client — their shipment still hasn't arrived. B: That's the third delay this quarter. Did the carrier give a reason? A: They mentioned a warehouse backlog, but they couldn't give a firm delivery date. B: Let's offer the client a discount on their next order as an apology.

subQuestions.question: What is the main issue being discussed?

choices.text: A client's shipment has been delayed
A carrier raised its shipping rates

subQuestions.explanation: 冒頭でAが顧客の荷物がまだ届いていないと伝えている。
subQuestions.translation: 主に話し合われている問題は何ですか。

subQuestions.question: What reason did the carrier give for the delay?

choices.text: An error in the shipping address

subQuestions.explanation: Aは"a warehouse backlog"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 運送業者は遅延の理由として何を挙げましたか。

subQuestions.question: What does B propose doing for the client?

choices.text: Filing a complaint against the carrier
Offering a discount on a future order
Sending a written apology letter only

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"offer the client a discount on their next order"と提案している。
subQuestions.translation: Bは顧客に対して何をすることを提案していますか。

questions.script: A: What did you think of the candidate we interviewed this morning? B: I was impressed — her experience matches the role closely, and she asked great questions. A: Agreed. Should we move forward with a second interview? B: Yes, let's schedule it for early next week and loop in the department manager.

subQuestions.question: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
subQuestions.explanation: 会話は今朝面接した候補者についての感想と次のステップを話している。
subQuestions.translation: 話者たちは主に何について話していますか。

subQuestions.question: According to B, what was impressive about the candidate?

choices.text: Her relevant experience and thoughtful questions

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"her experience matches the role closely, and she asked great questions"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Bは候補者の何に感心したと言っていますか。

subQuestions.question: What will most likely happen next?

choices.text: The candidate will be offered the job immediately
The position will be reopened for more applicants
A second interview will be scheduled

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"let's schedule it for early next week"と述べ、2回目の面接の設定を提案している。
subQuestions.translation: 次に何が起こる可能性が高いですか。

questions.script: A: Have we finalized the catering order for Friday's event? B: Almost — I'm still waiting to hear back about how many guests are vegetarian. A: I'll send a quick survey to the attendee list this afternoon. B: Perfect, let's finalize the order by tomorrow morning at the latest.

subQuestions.question: What are the speakers preparing for?
subQuestions.explanation: 会話全体が金曜日のイベントのケータリング手配について。
subQuestions.translation: 話者たちは何の準備をしていますか。

subQuestions.question: What information is B still waiting for?
subQuestions.explanation: Bは"waiting to hear back about how many guests are vegetarian"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Bはまだどんな情報を待っていますか。

subQuestions.question: What will A do this afternoon?
subQuestions.explanation: Aは"I'll send a quick survey to the attendee list this afternoon"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Aは今日の午後、何をしますか。

questions.script: A: Did you see the notice about the software upgrade this weekend? B: Yes, IT said all our files will automatically synchronize before the update starts. A: Good, I was worried I'd lose my project files. B: Same here — let's just save everything one more time on Friday to be safe.

subQuestions.question: What is the conversation mainly about?
subQuestions.explanation: 会話は週末のソフトウェアアップグレードの通知について。
subQuestions.translation: 会話は主に何についてですか。

subQuestions.question: According to B, what will happen before the update?

choices.text: Employees will be asked to work from home

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"all our files will automatically synchronize before the update starts"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Bによると、更新前に何が起こりますか。

subQuestions.question: What does B suggest doing on Friday?

choices.text: Backing up only the largest files
Saving all files again as a precaution

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"let's just save everything one more time on Friday to be safe"と提案している。
subQuestions.translation: Bは金曜日に何をすることを提案していますか。

questions.script: A: Have you finished putting together my itinerary for the conference next month? B: Almost — I booked your flight and hotel, but I'm still waiting on the shuttle reservation. A: No rush, just make sure I land with enough time before the opening reception. B: Understood, I'll confirm everything by the end of the week.

subQuestions.question: What is B helping A prepare for?
subQuestions.explanation: 会話は来月のカンファレンスに向けた旅程の準備について。
subQuestions.translation: Bは何のためにAをサポートしていますか。

subQuestions.question: What has B not finished yet?
subQuestions.explanation: Bは"I'm still waiting on the shuttle reservation"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Bはまだ何を終えていませんか。

subQuestions.question: What does A ask B to make sure of?

choices.text: That there is enough time to arrive before the opening reception
That the shuttle is free of charge
That the hotel has a gym

subQuestions.explanation: Aは"make sure I land with enough time before the opening reception"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Aは何を確実にするようBに求めていますか。

questions.script: A: The shelves in the front section look almost empty again. B: I know, our best-selling items keep selling out faster than we can restock them. A: Should we increase the order size for next month? B: Yes, and let's also move some inventory from the stockroom out front today.

subQuestions.question: What problem does A point out?
subQuestions.explanation: Aは"the shelves in the front section look almost empty again"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Aはどんな問題を指摘していますか。

subQuestions.question: Why are the shelves emptying quickly, according to B?

choices.text: Best-selling items sell out faster than they can restock
The store reduced its order size

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"our best-selling items keep selling out faster than we can restock them"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Bによると、なぜ棚がすぐ空になるのですか。

subQuestions.question: What will the speakers do today?

choices.text: Move inventory from the stockroom to the front

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"let's also move some inventory from the stockroom out front today"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 話者たちは今日、何をしますか。

questions.script: A: The vendor sent over the new contract terms for next year. B: How do the numbers compare to our current agreement? A: The overall cost is about the same, but they want to shorten the renewal period to six months. B: Let's negotiate for a full year before we sign anything.

subQuestions.question: What are the speakers discussing?

choices.text: Terms of a vendor contract renewal

subQuestions.explanation: 会話は来年度の契約条件についてで、更新期間の交渉が話題。
subQuestions.translation: 話者たちは何について話し合っていますか。

subQuestions.question: What change does the vendor want to make?

choices.text: Shortening the renewal period to six months

subQuestions.explanation: Aは"they want to shorten the renewal period to six months"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 業者はどんな変更を望んでいますか。

subQuestions.question: What does B want to do before signing?

choices.text: Accept the vendor's terms as is

subQuestions.explanation: Bは"Let's negotiate for a full year before we sign anything"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: Bは署名する前に何をしたいと考えていますか。

questions.script: Attention all building tenants: the east elevator will be out of service for routine maintenance from nine to eleven tomorrow morning. During that time, please use the west elevator or the stairs near the lobby. We apologize for any inconvenience and expect the elevator to be back in service by early afternoon.

subQuestions.question: Who is this announcement most likely for?

choices.text: People who work or live in the building

subQuestions.explanation: 冒頭"Attention all building tenants"から建物のテナント（入居者）向けの案内だと分かる。
subQuestions.translation: この案内はおそらく誰に向けたものですか。

subQuestions.question: When will the east elevator be unavailable?

choices.text: From nine to eleven tomorrow morning

subQuestions.explanation: "out of service...from nine to eleven tomorrow morning"と明示されている。
subQuestions.translation: 東側のエレベーターはいつ使用できませんか。

subQuestions.question: What are listeners advised to do during the maintenance?

choices.text: Wait in the lobby until it reopens
Use the west elevator or the stairs

subQuestions.explanation: "please use the west elevator or the stairs near the lobby"と案内している。
subQuestions.translation: メンテナンス中、聞き手は何をするよう勧められていますか。

questions.script: This weekend only, visit Harbor Outlet for our biggest clearance sale of the year. Every item in the store is marked down, with select merchandise up to seventy percent off. Doors open early at eight, and the first fifty customers will receive a complimentary gift bag. Don't miss this once-a-year event.

subQuestions.question: What is being advertised?
subQuestions.explanation: 冒頭で"our biggest clearance sale of the year"と明言している。
subQuestions.translation: 何が宣伝されていますか。

subQuestions.question: How much can customers save on select merchandise?
subQuestions.explanation: "select merchandise up to seventy percent off"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 一部の商品では、顧客はいくら節約できますか。

subQuestions.question: What will the first fifty customers receive?

choices.text: A discount coupon for next time

subQuestions.explanation: "the first fifty customers will receive a complimentary gift bag"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 最初の50人の客は何を受け取りますか。

questions.script: Hi, this is Dana calling from Crestview Dental. I'm calling to let you know that your appointment originally scheduled for Tuesday at ten needs to be moved due to a scheduling conflict. We have an opening on Wednesday at the same time. Please call us back at your convenience to confirm.

subQuestions.question: Why is Dana calling?

choices.text: To confirm a payment was received
To remind about an annual checkup

subQuestions.explanation: "your appointment...needs to be moved due to a scheduling conflict"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: デイナはなぜ電話をかけていますか。

subQuestions.question: What day was the appointment originally scheduled for?
subQuestions.explanation: "originally scheduled for Tuesday at ten"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 予約はもともと何曜日に予定されていましたか。

subQuestions.question: What does Dana ask the listener to do?

choices.text: Arrive early for the new appointment
Call back to confirm the new time

subQuestions.explanation: "Please call us back at your convenience to confirm"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: デイナは聞き手に何をするよう頼んでいますか。

questions.script: Attention passengers on flight two-fourteen to Denver: your departure gate has changed from gate twelve to gate twenty-three. Boarding will begin in approximately twenty minutes. Please proceed to the new gate as soon as possible, and have your boarding pass ready for the agent.

subQuestions.question: What is the purpose of this announcement?

choices.text: To inform passengers of a gate change
To call for volunteers to give up seats

subQuestions.explanation: "your departure gate has changed from gate twelve to gate twenty-three"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: この案内の目的は何ですか。

subQuestions.question: What is the new gate number?
subQuestions.explanation: "changed from gate twelve to gate twenty-three"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 新しい搭乗ゲートの番号は何番ですか。

subQuestions.question: What are passengers asked to have ready?
subQuestions.explanation: "have your boarding pass ready for the agent"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 乗客は何を準備しておくよう求められていますか。

questions.script: Welcome, everyone, to the Riverside History Museum. My name is Carlos, and I'll be your guide for the next hour. Let me walk you through today's itinerary: we'll begin in the main hall, where you'll see artifacts dating back over two hundred years, before moving on to the interactive exhibit on the second floor. Please feel free to ask questions along the way.

subQuestions.question: Who most likely is Carlos?

choices.text: A history professor giving a lecture

subQuestions.explanation: "I'll be your guide for the next hour"と自己紹介している。
subQuestions.translation: カルロスはおそらく誰ですか。

subQuestions.question: Where will the tour begin?
subQuestions.explanation: "We'll begin in the main hall"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: ツアーはどこから始まりますか。

subQuestions.question: What are listeners invited to do?

choices.text: Wait silently until the tour ends
Take photos only at the end

subQuestions.explanation: "Please feel free to ask questions along the way"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 聞き手は何をするよう勧められていますか。

questions.script: Good afternoon, everyone. Before we wrap up today's meeting, I want to share a quick update on our quarterly results. Revenue grew twelve percent compared to last quarter, largely thanks to strong sales in the retail division. I want to thank each of you for your hard work, and I look forward to sharing more details at next month's review.

subQuestions.question: What is the main purpose of this talk?

choices.text: To announce a new product launch
To explain a change in company policy

subQuestions.explanation: "I want to share a quick update on our quarterly results"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: この話の主な目的は何ですか。

subQuestions.question: By how much did revenue grow?
subQuestions.explanation: "Revenue grew twelve percent compared to last quarter"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 収益はどれくらい増加しましたか。

subQuestions.question: What does the speaker say contributed most to the growth?

choices.text: Strong sales in the retail division

subQuestions.explanation: "largely thanks to strong sales in the retail division"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 話者は何が最も成長に貢献したと述べていますか。

questions.script: Thank you all for coming today. I'm excited to introduce our newest product line, designed specifically to help small businesses streamline their daily operations. After months of testing and customer feedback, we're confident this launch will set a new standard in the industry. We'll be taking questions after a short demonstration.

subQuestions.question: What is the speaker mainly doing?
subQuestions.explanation: "I'm excited to introduce our newest product line"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 話者は主に何をしていますか。

subQuestions.question: Who is the new product designed for?
subQuestions.explanation: "designed specifically to help small businesses streamline their daily operations"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 新製品は誰のために設計されていますか。

subQuestions.question: What will happen after the demonstration?

choices.text: The event will end without further discussion
The audience will be able to ask questions
The product will go on sale immediately

subQuestions.explanation: "We'll be taking questions after a short demonstration"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: デモンストレーションの後、何が行われますか。

questions.script: Thank you for calling Meridian Bank customer service. For account balance and recent transactions, press one. To report a lost or stolen card, press two. To speak with a representative about a loan or mortgage, press three. For any other inquiry, please stay on the line and the next available representative will assist you.

subQuestions.question: What kind of business most likely recorded this message?
subQuestions.explanation: "Thank you for calling Meridian Bank customer service"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: この案内はおそらくどんな業種の企業が録音したものですか。

subQuestions.question: What should callers do to report a lost card?
subQuestions.explanation: "To report a lost or stolen card, press two"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: カードの紛失を報告するには何をすべきですか。

subQuestions.question: What should callers with other inquiries do?

choices.text: Stay on the line for a representative
Hang up and call back later

subQuestions.explanation: "For any other inquiry, please stay on the line and the next available representative will assist you"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: それ以外の問い合わせがある発信者はどうすべきですか。

keyVocab.sense: 入社時オリエンテーション

questions.script: Good morning, and welcome to your first day of orientation. Over the next two days, you'll learn about our company policies, meet your department supervisor, and complete a few required training modules. Please keep your employee badge visible at all times, and don't hesitate to ask your mentor if you have any questions.

subQuestions.question: Who is this talk intended for?
subQuestions.explanation: "welcome to your first day of orientation"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: この話は誰に向けたものですか。

subQuestions.question: What will listeners do over the next two days?

choices.text: Learn policies, meet a supervisor, and complete training

subQuestions.explanation: "you'll learn about our company policies, meet your department supervisor, and complete a few required training modules"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 聞き手は今後2日間で何をしますか。

subQuestions.question: What are listeners told to do if they have questions?
subQuestions.explanation: "don't hesitate to ask your mentor if you have any questions"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 質問がある場合、聞き手は何をするよう言われていますか。

questions.script: Good morning, commuters. Traffic on the downtown expressway is moving slowly this morning due to ongoing construction near exit seven. Drivers should expect delays of up to twenty minutes and may want to consider the riverside route as an alternative. We'll have another update in thirty minutes.

subQuestions.question: What is this report mainly about?

choices.text: Traffic conditions during the morning commute

subQuestions.explanation: "Good morning, commuters. Traffic on the downtown expressway is moving slowly"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: この報道は主に何についてですか。

subQuestions.question: Why is traffic moving slowly?
subQuestions.explanation: "due to ongoing construction near exit seven"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: なぜ交通の流れが遅くなっていますか。

subQuestions.question: What alternative does the reporter suggest?

choices.text: Waiting until after exit seven reopens

subQuestions.explanation: "may want to consider the riverside route as an alternative"と述べている。
subQuestions.translation: 話者はどんな代替案を提案していますか。
